document.abstract: ATSC 3.0 is the Next Gen TV broadcast emission system defined by the Advanced Television Systems Committee (ATSC) encompassing the entire terrestrial broadcast system from the physical layer to the applications and presentation layer. This paper offers an overview of the important advancements in the ATSC 3.0 Standard, which is designed to inspire today’s content creators, business leaders, and consumers.
